impact: Adds to the global chip relief bounce after the Asia rebound, a mild positive for MU, DRAM and SNXX sentiment going into Friday's shortened US session; NOK trades in Europe and benefits from the broad tech lift.
summary: European stocks opened sharply higher on Thursday after Wednesday's 1.06% drop to 626.03. Around 9:13 a.m. CET the Stoxx 600 was up 1.43% at 634.98 and the DAX up 1.72% at 25,127.68, with STMicroelectronics up 4.24%, Infineon 3.96% and ASML 2.62%. The move was described as a relief bounce helped by milder-than-feared US tariff proposals and a break from AI selling while US markets are closed for Thanksgiving. Figures are early-session.
title: Europe rebounds: Stoxx 600 up 1.4%, DAX 1.7% early as chipmakers lead
